text.zh: 在伦敦一所时髦的私立女子走读学校上学。
text.en: Attends a fashionable private girls' day school in London.

text.zh: 说自己有男朋友，是苏格兰一个 13 岁的男孩；他去上学时她在那边很孤单。
text.en: Says she has a boyfriend, a 13-year-old in Scotland, and feels lonely there while he is at school.

text.zh: 在女子寄宿学校 Southover Manor 读书。
text.en: Attends Southover Manor, a girls' boarding school.

text.zh: 住在苏格兰珀斯郡她父亲那座 4000 英亩的庄园里。
text.en: Lives on her father's 4,000-acre estate in Perthshire, Scotland.

text.zh: 她说珀斯郡的社交生活“挺有意思”；她骑马、游泳，打网球、乒乓球和槌球。
text.en: Calls the social life in Perthshire 'quite fun'; she rides, swims and plays tennis, table tennis and croquet.

text.zh: 16 岁离开学校，去了巴黎，并上了秘书学校。
text.en: Left school at 16, went to Paris and attended secretarial college.

text.zh: 做秘书工作。
text.en: Works as a secretary.

text.zh: 她说自己对婚姻很悲观，目前不想结婚，也不想要孩子。
text.en: Says she is very cynical about marriage and has no desire to marry or have children for now.

text.zh: 她 14 岁后不久父母离异；16 岁时她离开学校去了巴黎。
text.en: Her parents split up soon after she turned 14; she left school at 16 for Paris.

text.zh: 她说自己就是对学校没兴趣，只想离开。
text.en: Says she simply wasn't interested in school and just wanted to get away.

text.zh: 选择专心抚养家庭，而不是发展事业。
text.en: Chose to focus on raising her family rather than pursuing a career.

text.zh: 与 Rupert 结婚五年，有两个儿子 Thomas 和 Oliver。
text.en: Married to Rupert for five years, with two sons, Thomas and Oliver.

text.zh: 住在巴斯附近的一个小村庄。
text.en: Lives in a small village near Bath.

text.zh: 与 Rupert 结婚并生了两个儿子；父亲约在三年前去世。
text.en: Married Rupert and had two sons; her father died about three years before filming.

text.zh: 她把幸福部分归功于 Rupert；21 岁时她没有方向，如今觉得自己太安定，不会走偏。
text.en: Credits Rupert in part for her happiness; at 21 she had no direction, and now feels too settled to go off the rails.

text.zh: 已与 Rupert 结婚，育有三个孩子：Thomas、Oliver 和女儿 Laura。
text.en: Married to Rupert, with three children: Thomas, Oliver and daughter Laura.

text.zh: 生下女儿 Laura 并搬了家；Rupert 辞去律所合伙人自己开公司；母亲确诊肺癌。
text.en: Had a daughter, Laura, and moved house; Rupert left his law partnership for his own company; her mother was diagnosed with lung cancer.

text.zh: 她担心孩子们的生活太受呵护，将来难以面对外面的世界，希望能帮他们应付。
text.en: Worries her children's very cosseted life may leave them unready for the world, and hopes to help them cope.

text.zh: 完成了一个丧亲辅导课程。
text.en: Completed a bereavement counselling course.

text.zh: 过去 15 年在家带孩子；约四年前开始从事丧亲辅导。
text.en: Stayed home 15 years raising her children; got into bereavement counselling about four years before filming.

text.zh: 与 Rupert 结婚，育有三个孩子；长子 Tom 16 岁。
text.en: Married to Rupert with three children; eldest son Tom is 16.

text.zh: 母亲被查出癌症晚期，在她完成辅导课程后不久去世；Rupert 的公司经营良好。
text.en: Her mother, diagnosed with terminal cancer, died soon after Suzy finished her counselling course; Rupert's company was doing well.

text.zh: 她希望孩子们的家庭生活比她当年更安稳，只盼自己健康长寿，看着他们长大独立。
text.en: Hopes her children have a more stable home life than she had, and wants to stay healthy long enough to see them grow up.

text.zh: 已婚 27 年；Tom 在伦敦工作，Ollie 住在家里，Laura 在读 AS 课程。
text.en: Married to Rupert for 27 years; Tom works in London, Ollie lives at home and Laura is doing AS levels.

text.zh: 长子大学毕业后去伦敦工作生活；她说打算满 50 岁后退出这个系列。
text.en: Her eldest son graduated and moved to London; she said she planned to bow out of the series at 50.

text.zh: 她觉得拍片非常痛苦；她不外向、不自信，看重隐私，羡慕年轻人的自信。
text.en: Finds the films very painful; not outgoing or confident, she values her privacy and wishes she had young people's confidence.

text.zh: 做丧亲辅导工作；她说自己没有成功的事业，但感到充实。
text.en: Works as a bereavement counsellor; she says she has not had a successful career but feels fulfilled.

text.zh: 仍与 Rupert 保持婚姻，有两个成年儿子和一个女儿；女儿和长子上了大学。
text.en: Still married to Rupert, with two grown sons and a daughter; her daughter and eldest son went to university.

text.zh: 尽管 49 岁时说要退出，她还是再次参与，称是出于“一种可笑的忠诚感”。
text.en: Despite saying at 49 she would bow out, she took part again, citing 'this ridiculous sense of loyalty'.

text.zh: （事后得知）她决定不参与 63 Up；2019 年一篇访谈中，采访者把原因归于拍摄带来的心理包袱。
text.en: (Learned later) She chose not to take part in 63 Up; a 2019 interviewer put this down to the baggage of making the programme.

text.zh: 缺席 63 Up 后回归最后一部；她说比她年轻的朋友相继离世，让她庆幸自己身体还算健康。
text.en: Returned for the final film after sitting out 63 Up; she said younger friends' deaths made her feel fortunate to be reasonably healthy.

text.zh: 她育有三个孩子，后来成为丧亲辅导员；她说自己荒废了学业，但庆幸身体还算健康。
text.en: A mother of three who became a bereavement counsellor, she says she threw away her education but feels fortunate to be in reasonably good health.
